editorial:
Imagine living in a world that is totally trashed after World War III, where the only thing keeping you sane is hitting the arcade to play Street Fighter II. That is exactly where you find Soryong and Saeng. They are just two best friends who spend all their time fighting in the game, but their lives get flipped upside down when the real Chun Li walks right into their lives. She tells them they are the only ones who can stop the evil Bison from taking over what is left of the planet. It is a wild, funny ride that feels like a love letter to old-school gaming and friendship.

You will love how the movie mixes comedy with over-the-top action. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the plot jumps can feel a bit random. If you enjoy seeing game characters come to life, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a real collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go. It is the perfect flick for a lazy weekend with snacks.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Soryong and Saeng have to stop using their game skills and find real courage. They team up with Chun Li to face Bison in a massive battle. After a huge fight, they manage to defeat Bison by combining their strengths, which saves the world from his tyranny. The movie ends with the friends realizing that their bond is more important than any high score, leaving the world in a state of peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro games and goofy action movies.
